name: Clark County Aquatics: Lifeguard, Cashier and Swim Instructor Jobs
what_you_do: Staff work as lifeguards, cashiers and swim instructors at county pools.
who_can_apply: People 15 years and older. A swim skills test is part of the process.
pay_detail: Pay rate is not stated on the program page. Lifeguard training is paid.
duration: Seasonal pools are open to the public May to August. Other hours and dates are not stated on the program page.
deadline_text: No dates are given on the program page. The page itself has no date.
how_to_apply: Use the link on the program page to apply online. Then do the swim test: 50 yards of freestyle, 50 yards of freestyle with a rescue tube, tread water 1 minute without hands, and pick up a 10 pound object from the bottom.
notes: The county notice has no date, so check that hiring is still open. Phone: (702) 455-1708. County pools are different from City of Las Vegas pools.
